dialogues.speaker: Chatelet
dialogues.text: From the perspective of work, such trivial matters won't even make for good conversation — that much is true.

dialogues.speaker: Chatelet
dialogues.text: I'm a Gestionnaire at the Palais Mermonia. I guess you could call me an old colleague of Arouet's.

dialogues.speaker: Chatelet
dialogues.text: Arouet's opinions could be considered quite extreme in the office, but by cafe standards, they're quite ordinary.

dialogues.speaker: Chatelet
dialogues.text: It must be said, though, that there can be no complaints about his coffee-making skills. Quitting his old job to run this place has been one of the best decisions of his life.
